**Step: The learning rate \alpha can impact whether gradient descent converges to the true optimal weights.**

*Hint 1:* Consider how the learning rate \alpha affects the update step in gradient descent. A very small \alpha might lead to slow convergence, while a very large \alpha could cause the algorithm to overshoot the minimum.

*Hint 2:* Think about the role of the gradient vector in the update process. The learning rate \alpha scales the gradient, impacting how much the parameters are adjusted in each iteration. This scaling can influence whether the algorithm converges to the true optimal weights.
